pages.title: Chapter 6: Important Game Mechanics
pages.text: §7[Quality System]$(br2)Forged metal products have three quality levels that affect attributes:$(br2)$(li)§8Rough Quality§7: Attack -0.5$(br)$(li)§aNormal Quality§7: Standard attributes (normal range)$(br)$(li)§6Fine Quality§7: Attack +0.5$(br2)Quality is determined by the billet, randomly generated during crafting.

pages.title: §7[Cooling Mechanism]
pages.text: Softened billets have three cooling methods:$(br2)$(li)§6Water Cooling§r: Place softened billet in water to instantly cool it back to hard billet$(br)$(li)§6Auto Cooling§r: Softened copper billet auto-cools after 1.5 minutes in inventory$(br)$(li)§6Natural Cooling§r: Softened billet placed on ground gradually cools$(br2)Cooled billets lose their softened state and need re-heating for forging.

pages.title: §7[Other Useful Features]
pages.text: $(li)§bCooking Food§r: Fire pit can cook food and provide light$(br)$(li)§bAsh Fertilizer§r: Ash works as fertilizer to ripen plants$(br)$(li)§bRock Building§r: 9 rock types can make stairs, slabs and walls$(br)$(li)§bShift Tip§r: Hold Shift to view item details

pages.title: §7[Forging Safety Tips]
pages.text: $(li)§bHeat Protection§r: Use wooden clamp for hot items to avoid burns$(br)$(li)§bWork Hardening§r: Over-hammering causes metal to crack and break$(br)$(li)§bMaterial Match§r: Use the correct metal type's softened strip for carving$(br)$(li)§bDurability§r: Hammers and chisels wear out with use, keep spares

pages.title: §7[Advanced Tips]
pages.text: $(li)§bBatch Preparation§r: Heat multiple billets at once for efficiency$(br)$(li)§bQuality Selection§r: Re-craft billets until you get fine quality$(br)$(li)§bQuick Find§r: Use /forgeodyssey find commands to locate resources$(br)$(li)§bTime Management§r: Watch for softened billet cooling time, forge promptly
